1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto de hasta 1 m de altura, de ramas opuestas, hojas pequeñas, ovaladas, lustrosas y duras, flores blancas, y una baya roja como fruto, casi redonda, coronada por los cuatro dientes del cáliz, de agradable sabor y aroma. Myrtaceae, Ugni molinae.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Shrub reaching up to 1 m in height, with opposite branches, small oval-shaped leaves that are glossy and hard, white flowers, and a red berry-like fruit that is almost round, crowned by the four teeth of the calyx, having an agreeable taste and aroma. Myrtaceae, Ugni molinae.
